text:
lina (support): Heads-up — customer NorthBridge Ltd (acct nb-781) opened a ticket: INV-2026-457 shows 20% VAT applied even though they provided an Irish VAT number IE12345678 and are B2B. They want a correction and a credit.

miriam (acct-ops): I pulled the invoice PDF and the customer's VAT ID is on file, screenshot: https://files.redwood.ai/nb-781/vat-screenshot.png (customer-supplied). Billing address in the invoice shows Dublin, IE.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-457 created by job billing-worker-3 at 2026-06-01T09:12:11Z; tax_amount=EUR 200.00; tax_rate=20.00%; tax_country_resolved=GB.

sam (billing-eng): On it. Initial hunch: tax resolver might be preferring org.default_country over billing_address.country after the "country-mapping" migration last week. Can you paste the invoice JSON?

lina (support): Copying invoice payload from logs below.

```json
{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-457","account_id":"nb-781","org":{"id":"org-993","default_country":"GB"},"billing_address":{"country":"IE","line1":"1 Exchange Plaza","city":"Dublin"},"vat_number":"IE12345678","items":[{"sku":"dedicated-month","amount":1000}],"created_at":"2026-06-01T09:12:10Z"}
```

sam (billing-eng): Thanks. Repro steps I’ll run locally: POST same payload to staging resolver. Suspect code path in billing_resolver.py where we do: `resolved_country = org.country or billing_address.country` (wrong priority). Should be billing_address > org.default_country > ip_geo.

sam (billing-eng): Running quick test...

billing-bot: staging-invoice INV-STG-00023 created; tax_rate=20.00%; tax_country_resolved=GB.

sam (billing-eng): Reproduced on staging. Confirmed: resolver used org.default_country because org field is non-null. Patch ready: prefer billing_address.country if present. Small hotfix, planning to deploy to prod in a few minutes and then re-run invoice calculation.

deploy-bot: deploy billing-resolver v2.1.7 -> prod started by sam at 2026-06-01T09:25:00Z

sam (billing-eng): Patch deployed. Re-calculating INV-2026-457 with corrected resolver.

billing-bot: recheck INV-2026-457 recalculated; tax_rate=0.00%; tax_amount=EUR 0.00; tax_country_resolved=IE.

miriam (acct-ops): Issued credit note CN-2026-99 for full tax amount EUR 200.00 and reissued invoice INV-2026-458 with VAT 0% (reverse charge). Customer notified and credit processed to original payment method.

lina (support): Customer confirmed receipt of credit and new invoice. They asked for an explanation of what happened.

sam (billing-eng): Root cause: migration introduced a country-mapping that set org.default_country on import for legacy accounts. Resolver logic prioritized org.default_country over explicit billing_address. Fix: change priority, add unit test for billing_address presence, and add a health check that flags accounts where org.default_country != billing_address.country for B2B accounts.

miriam (acct-ops): I'll run a query for accounts with non-null vat_number where tax was charged in last 90 days and org.default_country != billing_address.country, then we can batch-check for mis-applied VAT. Adding to ops queue: HIGH.

lina (support): Thanks team. I'll add a short apology note template and mark the support ticket resolved once ops batch is started.

sam (billing-eng): Also adding a monitoring alert on tax_country_resolved != billing_address.country for future invoices.

lina (support): Closing loop here. If ops finds more, we'll open follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
